name: nil-optimization-test-dc36749029/nil_optimizations-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions / Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported" (lists ballerina/lang.* libraries)
reason: The assertions check that nil and integer values in optional int and int|decimal unions satisfy exactly their corresponding nil/int/decimal type tests. Local declarations, nil and numeric literals, calls, and type tests are supported, with no applicable restriction excluding these union type tests. The ballerina/test assertions are not langlib calls covered by the ballerina/lang.* restriction.
test_design_notes: Covers both nil and integer values in each union; decimal is tested as a nonmatching alternative, without constructing a decimal value.
